verdict.rationale: Increase documents separating Accounts from Account Numbers. You can programmatically create multiple Account Numbers under a single Account (a one-to-many, master/sub structure) and give each counterparty or customer a unique number for automatic reconciliation across ACH, wire, RTP and check. A customer case study (Ramp) spins up unique accounts per user, and another (Ascend) describes building FBO accounts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of a multi-level sub-account hierarchy, and stated scale limits or throughput for number issuance.
